item.title: Colts QB Philip Rivers’ connection with IU head coach Curt Cignetti
item.description: Indiana University head football coach Curt Cignetti once coached Philip Rivers, when Cignetti was an assistant coach at NC State.

item.title: Former Little League star Mo’ne Davis joins inaugural Women’s Pro Baseball League
item.description: Mo'ne Davis, a Little League World Series standout, was selected 10th overall in the inaugural Women's Pro Baseball League draft, continuing her journey in America's pastime and marking a major milestone for women's sports.

item.title: Indiana’s new vehicle registration law takes effect Jan. 1
item.description: Hoosiers are required to update their vehicle registration if their vehicle's exterior appearance has changed, and failure to do so could result in a warning from law enforcement or a Class C misdemeanor.

item.title: IMPD: Man hit by stray bullet on New Year’s Day
item.description: A man was wounded by a stray bullet that fell from the sky on New Year's Day in Indianapolis, prompting police to remind residents of the danger of firing guns into the air during celebrations.

item.title: Crowds turn out for First Day Hikes
item.description: Indiana and other states offered guided hikes as part of their annual First Day Hikes program, which has been held in all 50 states since 2012, to encourage people to get outdoors and enjoy nature.

item.title: IU takes down Alabama to win the Rose Bowl, advance in CFP
item.description: IU beat Alabama in the Rose Bowl, marking their first Rose Bowl win in program history, and will face Oregon in the Peach Bowl in the College Football Playoff semifinals.

item.title: IU fans celebrate historic Rose Bowl win over Alabama
item.description: Indiana University fans celebrated a dominant 38-3 victory over Alabama in the Rose Bowl, with hundreds of fans gathering at Kilroy's Bar N' Grill in downtown Indianapolis.
